title: Write Testbench for Full Adder
statement: Write a testbench for a given full adder module. The testbench should instantiate the full adder, apply all input combinations, and verify the sum and carry outputs. The expected waveform or prints should be checked automatically in simulation.
behavior: Instantiate the provided full adder module.
Apply all eight combinations of inputs a, b, and cin.
Compare outputs to expected sum and cout values.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not modify the full adder DUT; the testbench should remain separate.
hint: Use $display and a loop to verify all input combinations.
